description: C#'s Trim removes Unicode boundary whitespace and preserves internal spaces and tabs
code:
edge = String.fromCharCode(160, 8195)
text = edge + "Zoë  😀\t x" + edge
assert(text.Trim(), "Zoë  😀\t x")
assert(text.Trim(), text.trim())
text.Trim()

description: A trimmed display follows later changes to its raw label
code:
raw = "  Ada  "
display = raw.Trim()
assert(display, "Ada")
raw = "\t Bo \n"
assert(display, "Bo")
display

description: A class rule trims each label while keeping its raw text intact
code:
class Label(raw):
    this.raw = raw
$Label.display = $Label.raw.Trim()
label = Label("  first  ")
assert(label.display, "first")
label.raw = "  second\t"
assert([label.raw, label.display], ["  second\t", "second"])
label.display

description: Trim evaluates supplied arguments but does not interpret them as character trimming
code:
log = []
def supplied():
    log.push("argument")
    return "x"
assert("  xoxo  ".Trim(supplied()), "xoxo")
assert(log, ["argument"])
log
